failure_policy: Reject or narrow the claim; retain finite 2e-5 gate, cache-aware 10% floor and swap/process/deadline stops.
limitations: Synthetic same-input block replay; no full conditioning, diffusion, full checkpoint, video generation, quality or speed qualification.
RoPE tables are generated by upstream on MPS and uploaded as fixture inputs; native application, not a new native ND table generator, is qualified.
The upstream attention adapter uses PyTorch MPS F32 SDPA; CUDA/Magi and BF16 activation semantics remain open.
CLI reference SHA is operator-trusted; receipt provenance is not hostile-producer authentication; local files must remain immutable.
BF16 cache conversion receipts are retained; this slice freshly reruns both upstream neural blocks and authenticates the qualified cache files.
Setup file I/O/uploads and postterminal streamed diagnostics run on CPU; neural execution and hidden-state handoff remain on GPU.
Named-byte arithmetic and sampled memory guards do not prove instantaneous peaks or causal memory/performance improvement.
Companion object bytes are pinned but copied from the prior build with opaque source ancestry; build is not hermetic.
Identity RoPE is a broad numerical falsifier, not a dedicated axis/channel permutation experiment.
next_frontier: Extend authenticated BF16 cache coverage beyond two blocks and qualify bounded N-block execution before full conditioning/generation.

scope: Actual pretrained blocks 0->1 at B1/V5280/T1280/C2048/H16/D128/FF8192, synthetic MPS hidden inputs, upstream ND RoPE; native BF16 parameters/F32 math and MPS SDPA C256/G16.
